headline: Mistakes to Avoid When Choosing Kitchen Flooring
articleBody: Picking the right kitchen flooring can be tougher than it looks, and there are a few common blunders folks make. First, ignoring durability is a huge no-no. Your kitchen sees heavy foot traffic, spills, and drops, so choosing a floor that can't stand up to that abuse will lead to quick regret. Another mistake is forgetting about water resistance; kitchens are prone to splashes and leaks, so materials like laminate without proper sealing or certain hardwoods can be problematic. Don't overlook comfort and acoustics either. Hard, cold surfaces like ceramic tile can be tough on your feet and make the kitchen feel noisy. Budgeting only for the material cost and forgetting about installation, subfloor prep, and removal of old flooring is another common pitfall that can lead to unexpected expenses. Finally, picking a trend that doesn't fit your home's overall style or your personal taste means you'll be tired of it sooner rather than later. To steer clear of these issues, really think about your lifestyle and consult with a professional.
